env.name: gammaloop-nextest-binaries-core-gammaloop-api-0.1.0
env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
cargo --version
mkdir -p "$out"
if [ -d target ]; then
  chmod -R u+w target
  find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete
fi
cargo nextest --version
cargo nextest archive \
  --cargo-profile ci-optim \
  --offline -p gammaloop-api --features gammaloop-api/cli,gammaloop-api/python_stubgen,gammaloop-api/ufo_support,pyo3-stub-gen/infer_signature,pyo3-stub-gen/numpy,pyo3/anyhow,pyo3/auto-initialize,pyo3/eyre,pyo3/macros,pyo3/multiple-pymethods \
  -E 'package(gammaloop-api)' \
  --profile ci_gammaloop \
  --archive-file "$out/gammaloop-nextest-core-gammaloop-api.tar.zst"

runHook postBuild
